h1:
Michelin Restaurants in Thailand 2026
The Complete List, Every Tier
intro: The MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026 (announced November 27, 2025) awarded 485 restaurants across 12 provinces — this page gathers every tier on one page, from Three Stars down to Bib Gourmand with Thai names included. Use it as a year-round checklist.
quickAnswerHtml: The 2026 edition of the MICHELIN Guide Thailand awarded 485 restaurants — 2 Three Stars (Sorn and Sühring, newly promoted this year), 8 Two Stars, 33 One Stars, 137 Bib Gourmand (great food at a fair price), 5 Green Stars, and another 305 MICHELIN Selected, spread across 12 provinces nationwide.

blocks.html:
This is another historic year for Thai dining — Sühring was promoted to the country's second Three Star restaurant, joining Sorn, which has held the top spot since the previous edition. In total, the 2026 guide carries 43 starred restaurants, with 10 new entries and promotions this year. For value-driven eating, Bib Gourmand runs 137 restaurants deep, from roadside fish porridge stalls to century-old boat noodle shops.

We compiled this full list from the official announcement and the actual guide pages, restaurant by restaurant, including the Thai names for every Bib Gourmand entry. Found one you like? Head to the city deep-dive pages and tap 🔖 to save it to your plan.

items.name: ⭐⭐⭐ Sorn
items.blurb: Chef Ice (Supaksorn)'s legendary Southern Thai cooking — the first Three Star restaurant in the history of the Thai Michelin guide (since the 2025 edition). Ingredients come straight from the South to the kitchen. One of the hardest tables to book in Asia.

items.name: ⭐⭐⭐ Sühring
items.blurb: German twin chefs Thomas & Mathias Sühring serve contemporary German cooking in an old house in Sathorn — Thailand's second restaurant to earn Three Stars (promoted from Two Stars in the 2026 edition).

items.name: ⭐⭐ Baan Tepa
items.blurb: Modern Thai cooking in a garden house in Ramkhamhaeng, also holding a Green Star for sustainability — the only Two Star restaurant to hold both.

items.name: ⭐⭐ Chef's Table
items.blurb: A French dining room high above the Chao Phraya River, with a classic tasting menu that has held Two Stars continuously.

items.name: ⭐⭐ Côte by Mauro Colagreco
items.blurb: Award-winning chefs from the French Riviera, built around Mediterranean ingredients with a bold wine pairing program.

items.name: ⭐⭐ Gaa
items.blurb: Contemporary Indian cooking from Chef Garima Arora, the first Indian woman to earn a Michelin star, telling India's story through Thai ingredients.

items.name: ⭐⭐ Anne-Sophie Pic at Le Normandie
items.blurb: The Mandarin Oriental's legendary French dining room, led by the female chef with the most Michelin stars in the world — promoted to Two Stars this year.
items.meta: Bangkok · French (Contemporary French) · ⬆️ Promoted this year

items.name: ⭐⭐ INDDEE
items.blurb: The city's fastest-rising modern Indian restaurant, promoted from One Star to Two Stars in the 2026 edition.
items.meta: Bangkok · Indian (Modern Indian) · ⬆️ Promoted this year

items.name: ⭐⭐ Mezzaluna
items.blurb: Fine dining on the 65th floor of Lebua, with a signature city view and a modern European tasting menu.

items.name: ⭐⭐ R-Haan
items.blurb: Royal Thai cuisine that has held Two Stars continuously — a great choice for a big Thai meal on your trip.

blocks.html: The One Star tier has 7 new entries and promotions this year. Most are in Bangkok, but 4 sit outside the capital — two riverside restaurants in Nonthaburi, one deep in the forests of Phang Nga, and one on a farm in Phuket.

blocks.text: 🍽️ Bib Gourmand — 137 restaurants of great food at a fair price, by province

blocks.html: Bib Gourmand is the reason ordinary diners like us can follow the Michelin guide and enjoy it — inspectors look for good-quality food at an accessible price. This year adds 13 new restaurants (marked 🆕 in the tables), and several provinces have their own list for the first time. Thai restaurant names are included in parentheses, handy for searching further or telling a taxi driver.

blocks.text: ▫️ MICHELIN Selected — another 305 restaurants that meet inspector standards

blocks.html: Beyond stars and Bib Gourmand, the guide also has a MICHELIN Selected tier (formerly called The Plate) — restaurants inspectors have actually eaten at and certified as meeting the standard, even without a top award. The 2026 edition launched with 288 restaurants, and Michelin has been adding more through the year, now standing at around 305. We keep following this list and will keep pulling out standout restaurants for the province-level pages.

blocks.title: How to book a starred restaurant in time
blocks.html: Most Three Star and Two Star restaurants open bookings roughly 1–3 months ahead through their own website or platforms like TableCheck, and Friday-Saturday dinner seats go first. The trick is a weekday lunch — a shorter course but a much lighter price. Most Bib Gourmand restaurants don't take reservations at all; just line up at opening time.

blocks.title: Know this before you chase the Michelin trail

items.title: Budgets vary tenfold
items.text: Bib Gourmand starts in the tens to low hundreds of baht per person. A street-food One Star like Jay Fai runs into the thousands. A Three Star tasting menu lands around 10,000+ THB. Set your budget first and choosing a restaurant gets a lot easier.

items.title: Most Bib restaurants take cash
items.text: Many shophouse and street-food restaurants still only accept cash or PromptPay. Carry cash to be safe.

items.title: The queues are real
items.text: Famous spots like Jay Fai or well-known Bib restaurants can mean an hour-long wait. Arrive before opening time or avoid weekends to cut the wait significantly.

items.title: Dress codes apply at fine dining only
items.text: Most fine-dining restaurants ask for smart casual (no flip-flops or shorts). Bib Gourmand and Selected restaurants are come-as-you-are.

items.title: The list shifts every year
items.text: Michelin announces a new edition around late November each year, and adds Selected restaurants throughout the year — this page tracks the official announcements. Check the last-updated date at the top of the article.

faq.q: How many restaurants are in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026?
faq.a: 485 in total — 2 Three Stars, 8 Two Stars, 33 One Stars, 137 Bib Gourmand, and 305 MICHELIN Selected (the Selected count rises through the year as Michelin adds more), plus 5 Green Stars for sustainability that are paired with a main tier.

faq.q: Which restaurants in Thailand hold Three Michelin Stars?
faq.a: There are 2, both in Bangkok — Sorn, Southern Thai cooking and Thailand's first Three Star restaurant, and Sühring, contemporary German cooking, newly promoted from Two Stars in the 2026 edition.

faq.q: What is Bib Gourmand, and how is it different from a star?
faq.a: It's an award for good food at a fair price — Michelin inspectors pick restaurants offering a satisfying, quality meal for roughly under 1,000 THB per person. The 2026 edition has 137 restaurants nationwide, from rice-and-curry stalls and noodle shops to third-generation shophouses a century old. A Michelin star, by contrast, rewards culinary excellence with no price ceiling.

The 2026 guide covers 12 provinces — Bangkok and Greater Bangkok (Nonthaburi, Nakhon Pathom, Pathum Thani, Samut Sakhon), Chiang Mai, Phuket, Phang Nga, Khon Kaen, Udon Thani, Nakhon Ratchasima, Ubon Ratchathani, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Chonburi, and Surat Thani-Koh Samui, which just joined the guide for the first time.

faq.q: Do Michelin restaurants require a reservation?
faq.a: Starred restaurants, especially Three Star and Two Star, should be booked 1–3 months ahead through the restaurant's website or TableCheck/Chope. Most Bib Gourmand restaurants don't take reservations — just queue up in person. Popular spots have long lines at lunch and dinner on weekends, so arrive before opening.

faq.q: When was this list last updated?
faq.a: Compiled from the official 2026 announcement (November 27, 2025) and cross-checked against the official guide pages as of July 2026 — Michelin adds Selected restaurants through the year, and we keep this updated. Check the date at the top of the article.
